blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur long sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. A hypothesis is:
(Hypothesis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis (7.1) testing se pehle ka mafrooza (assumption) ya bayan hai jo nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai aur phir data se test hota hai; yani tajweez ki hui wazahat, aakhri nateeja nahi.

blocks.prompt:
2. The null hypothesis represents:
(Null hypothesis kis cheez ko dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis (7.2) kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahi; yeh default mafrooza hai jis ke khilaf data test hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. The symbol used for the null hypothesis is:
(Null hypothesis ki alamat kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Null hypothesis ki alamat H₀ hai (7.2); H₁ (ya Hₐ) alternative hypothesis hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab MCQ 3 aur 5 mein alamatein typesetting code ki shakal mein chhapti hai: (H_1), (H_2), (H_0), (H_x). In ka matlab H₁, H₂, H₀ aur Hₓ hai; upar yahi likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. A p-value is used for:
(p-value kis kaam aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: p-value (7.3) null hypothesis ke khilaf saboot ki taqat batati hai aur significance level se mila kar faisla hota hai; yani hypothesis test karne ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
5. If p-value < α, the decision is to:
(Agar p-value < α ho to faisla kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Decision rule (7.3, 7.4): p-value agar α (significance level) se kam ho to null hypothesis reject hota hai, jaise kitab ki misal 0.03 < 0.05.

blocks.prompt:
6. The critical region is the:
(Critical region kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Critical region (7.3) values ki woh range hai jis mein test statistic aa jaye to null hypothesis reject hota hai; yani rejection area.

blocks.prompt:
7. An example of a test statistic is:
(Test statistic ki misal kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Test statistics (7.3) sample data se nikali values hain jin se nataij ka muqabla hota hai; kitab ki misalein t-value aur chi-square value hain. Mean, mode, median sirf ausat hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Data visualisation is used to:
(Data visualisation kis liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: Data visualisation (7.5) charts aur graphs se data ko saaf aur samajh aane wali shakal mein pesh karti hai, taake nataij samajhna aur batana aasan ho.

blocks.prompt:
9. A chart useful for comparison is:
(Muqable (comparison) ke liye kaunsa chart mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bar chart (7.5) categories ya groups ka muqabla karne ke liye mufeed hai; pie chart hisse aur percentage dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
10. Bias in data means:
(Data mein bias ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bias (7.6) tab hota hai jab data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi na kare; is se nataij gumrah-kun hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is a hypothesis?
Hypothesis kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis testing se pehle ka mafrooza (assumption) ya bayan hai jise data se test kiya ja sakta hai.
- Yeh nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai, is liye wazeh aur napne ke qabil (measurable) ho.
- Analysis ko rasta aur focus deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. What is a research question?
Research question kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Research question batata hai ke kya parha/tehqeeq kiya ja raha hai.
- Yeh data jama karne ki rehnumai karta hai.
- Is se hypothesis banta hai jo mumkina jawab hai; wazeh sawal se wazeh hypothesis.
Misal: Kya parhai ka waqt exam marks par asar dalta hai?

blocks.prompt:
3. Define null hypothesis (H₀).
Null hypothesis (H₀) ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Null hypothesis (H₀) kehta hai ke koi asar, farq ya rishta nahi. Yeh default mafrooza hai jis ke khilaf data test hota hai; saboot mazboot ho to reject hota hai.
Misal: Parhai ke waqt aur exam marks mein koi khaas rishta nahi.

blocks.prompt:
4. What is a test statistic?
Test statistic kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Test statistic sample data se nikali gayi ek adadi qeemat (number) hai jo data ka khulasa karti aur batati hai ke nataij H₀ ki tawaqqo se kitne door hain. Is se H₀ reject karne ka faisla hota hai.
Misal: t-value, chi-square value, F-value.

blocks.prompt:
5. What is meant by p-value?
p-value se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation:
p-value woh probability (imkaan) hai ke H₀ sach hone ki surat mein dekha gaya nateeja ya us se bhi zyada intehai nateeja aaye. Yeh H₀ ke khilaf saboot ki taqat batati hai.
Ise α (jaise 0.05) se milate hain: p < α ho to H₀ reject. Misal: p = 0.03 < 0.05.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is a critical region?
Critical region kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Critical region test statistic ki values ki woh range hai jis mein null hypothesis reject hota hai.
- Testing se pehle tay hoti hai aur significance level (α) par munhasir hai.
- Intehai (extreme) nataij ka hissa, yani rejection area.

blocks.prompt:
7. What are the basic steps in hypothesis testing?
Hypothesis testing ke bunyadi qadam kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Null aur alternative hypotheses likhna.
2. Significance level (α) chunna.
3. Sample data jama karna.
4. Test statistic aur p-value nikalna.
5. α se muqabla aur faisla: p < α ho to H₀ reject, warna nahi.

blocks.prompt:
8. Why is data visualization important?
Data visualization kyun zaroori hai?

9. What is bias in data collection?
Data jama karne mein bias kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Bias tab hota hai jab jama kiya gaya data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi na kare, mehdood sources ya ghalat sampling ki wajah se. Is se nataij ghalat aur gumrah-kun hote hain.
Misal: sehat ki study mein sirf jawan log hon to boorhon ki numaindagi nahi (sampling bias).

blocks.prompt:
10. Why is ethical use of data important?
Data ka akhlaqi (ethical) istemal kyun zaroori hai?

1. Explain the concept of hypothesis testing and its role in data analysis.
Hypothesis testing ka tasawwur aur data analysis mein is ka kirdar samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis testing data ki madad se faisla karne ka tareeqa hai. Yeh check karti hai ke koi mafrooza (hypothesis) sach hai ya ghalat, ek wazeh process ke zariye jis se use accept ya reject kiya jata hai.

Hypothesis: testing se pehle ka bayan jo nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai; wazeh aur measurable ho. Yeh research question se banta hai, jo batata hai ke kya parha ja raha hai aur data jama karne ki rehnumai karta hai.
Machine learning mein hypothesis function hθ(x) = y bhi likha jata hai: x input, θ model ke parameters, y predicted output.

Data analysis mein kirdar:
- Data ka mantiqi (logical) analysis; nataij ahem hain ya ittefaq, yeh check karna.
- Andhe nateejon aur andazon (guesswork) se bachao.
- Nataij ka tawaqqo se muqabla.
- Durusti aur saboot par mabni faisle; experiments aur surveys mein istemal.
- Nataij par aitmaad barhta hai.

Misal: school dekhna chahta hai ke naya teaching method marks barhata hai. H₀: koi behtari nahi; H₁: marks barhte hain. Students ka data analyse hota hai aur p < 0.05 ho to H₀ reject.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing ko adalat ki tarah samjhein: shuru mein maan liya jata hai ke mulzim be-gunah hai (H₀: koi asar nahi). Sirf mazboot saboot (chhoti p-value) milne par hi yeh maan-na chhora jata hai (H₀ reject).

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe different types of hypotheses and explain how to formulate correct hypotheses.
Hypotheses ki mukhtalif qismein bataiye aur samjhaiye ke durust hypotheses kaise banate hain.
blocks.explanation:
Hypotheses ki qismein hain; sab se aam null aur alternative hypothesis hain jo testing mein saath kaam karte hain aur hypothesis testing ki bunyad hain.

1. Null hypothesis (H₀): kehta hai ke koi asar ya farq nahi. Default mafrooza; data is ke khilaf test hota hai aur sirf mazboot saboot par reject hota hai. Bias se bachata aur muqable ki bunyad deta hai.

2. Alternative hypothesis (H₁ ya Hₐ): kehta hai ke asar ya farq hai; H₀ ka ulat. Tabdeeli ya asar dikhata hai, tehqeeq ko rasta deta hai; testing ka maqsad aksar isi ki tasdeeq hota hai, magar is ke liye bhi mazboot saboot chahiye.

Misal:
Research question: Kya parhai ka waqt exam marks par asar dalta hai?
H₀: Parhai ke waqt aur marks mein koi khaas rishta nahi.
H₁: Parhai ka waqt marks par khaas asar dalta hai.

Durust hypothesis banane ke usool:
- Wazeh aur mukhtasar (specific); mubham (vague) bayan durusti kam karta hai.
- Data se test ho sake.
- Research question ke mutabiq ho.
- Variables (badalne wali cheezein) wazeh hon.
- Saada zaban.
Sahi hypothesis waqt bachata aur bharosemand nataij deta hai.

rows: Default mafrooza jis ke khilaf data test hota hai
H₀ ka ulat; study aksar isi ki tasdeeq chahti hai
Parhai ke waqt aur marks mein koi rishta nahi
Parhai ka waqt marks par asar dalta hai

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain key concepts in hypothesis testing, including test statistics, critical region, and p-value.
Hypothesis testing ke aham concepts samjhaiye: test statistics, critical region aur p-value.
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis testing mein kai concepts mil kar faisla karte hain ke hypothesis accept ho ya reject.

1. Test statistic: sample data se nikali ek adadi qeemat jo data ka khulasa kare aur bataye ke nataij tawaqqo se kitne door hain. Misal: t-value, chi-square value.
t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s / √n)
Kitab ki misal: n = 25, x̄ = 80, μ₀ = 75, s = 10 -> t = (80 − 75) / (10 / √25) = 5 / 2 = 2.5
Chi-square: χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)² / Eᵢ; dice 60 dafa (dekhe gaye 10, 12, 8, 14, 9, 7; tawaqqo har ek 10): χ² = 0 + 0.4 + 0.4 + 1.6 + 0.1 + 0.9 = 3.4

2. Critical region: values ki woh range jis mein test statistic aaye to H₀ reject. Testing se pehle tay, significance level par munhasir, intehai nataij ka hissa; aksar graph par dikhayi jaati hai.

3. Significance level (α): ghalti ka qabil-e-qubool khatra, aam taur par 0.05; analysis se pehle chuna jata hai; chhoti value = sakht test.

4. p-value: H₀ sach ho to dekha gaya ya us se zyada intehai nateeja aane ka imkaan. Chhoti p-value H₀ ke khilaf saboot. α se muqabla: p < α to H₀ reject.
Misal: naye teaching method par p = 0.03; 0.03 < 0.05 is liye H₀ (koi asar nahi) reject. Dawa ki misal mein p = 0.01 mazboot saboot hai ke behtari ittefaq nahi.

Ahmiyat: yeh concepts faisle aasan banate aur baghair saboot ke accept/reject karne se bachate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: t-value ka hisaab qadam ba qadam: pehle farq 80 − 75 = 5. Phir √25 = 5, aur 10 / 5 = 2 (standard error). Aakhir mein 5 / 2 = 2.5. Jitni bari t-value, utna nateeja H₀ se door, aur reject hone ka imkaan zyada.

blocks.prompt:
4. Discuss the steps involved in performing hypothesis testing with a suitable example.
Hypothesis testing ke qadam kisi munasib misaal ke saath bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis testing ek wazeh process par chalti hai (Figure 7.1), jis se ghaltiyan kam aur testing munsifana hoti hai.

Qadam:
1. Null aur alternative hypotheses likhna.
2. Significance level (α) tay karna.
3. Sample data jama karna.
4. Test statistic nikalna.
5. p-value maloom karna.
6. p-value ka α se muqabla (decision rule).
7. Faisla aur nateeja: p < α to H₀ reject; p > α to H₀ reject nahi.

Misal (kitab): school ki pichli ausat 70 thi. Naye tareeqe se parhe 10 students ke marks: 72, 75, 78, 74, 77, 80, 76, 79, 81, 78.
Qadam 1: H₀: μ = 70 (koi behtari nahi); H₁: μ > 70 (marks barhe).
Qadam 2: α = 0.05.
Qadam 3: x̄ = 770 / 10 = 77.
Qadam 4: s = √(Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1)) = √(70 / 9) ≈ 2.79.
Qadam 5: t = (77 − 70) / (2.79 / √10) ≈ 7 / 0.88 ≈ 7.93.
Qadam 6: df = 10 − 1 = 9; t = 7.93 ki p-value bohat chhoti (one-tailed taqreeban 0.00001; kitab 0.00002 likhti hai), yani p < 0.05.
Qadam 7: p < α, is liye H₀ reject. Nateeja: naya teaching method marks ko khaas tor par behtar karta hai.

Advanced tests: F-test variances ka muqabla karta hai, F = S₁² / S₂² (misal 16 / 9 = 1.78, F-table se muqabla); chi-square test categorical data mein rishte check karta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hisaab dobara: 72+75+78+74+77+80+76+79+81+78 = 770, to mean 77. Har mark ka 77 se farq ka square jama karein to 70 aata hai; 70 / 9 = 7.78 aur is ka square root 2.79. √10 ≈ 3.16, to 2.79 / 3.16 ≈ 0.88; aur 7 / 0.88 ≈ 7.93. Itni bari t-value ka matlab hai p-value bohat chhoti, is liye H₀ reject.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the importance of data visualization in hypothesis testing and how graphs help present results.
Hypothesis testing mein data visualization ki ahmiyat aur graphs se nataij pesh karna samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation:
Data visualisation data ko saaf aur samajh aane wali shakal mein pesh karti hai aur hypothesis testing ko wazeh aur durust banati hai.

Ahmiyat:
- Raw data ko ba-maani tasweeri shakal (visual form) mein badalti hai.
- Statistical test se pehle patterns, trends aur rishte dikhati hai.
- Bare datasets ko samajhna aasan jo sirf numbers se mushkil hain.
- Trends, distribution aur farq numaya; outliers aur anomalies (ajeeb values) pakarti hai.
- Ajeeb patterns nazar aane se ghaltiyan aur ghalat-fehmi kam.
- Technical aur ghair-technical dono logon ko nataij batana aasan; tasweeri saboot se behtar faisle.

Nataij ke liye graphs aur charts:
- Bar chart: categories ya groups ka muqabla (control vs treatment group).
- Line graph: waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeli.
- Pie chart: hisse aur percentage.
- Scatter plot: do variables ka rishta.

Visuals ko hypotheses se jorna: graph se dekha ja sakta hai ke data hypothesis ki tasdeeq karta hai ya nahi. Comparison graph control aur experimental group ka farq dikhata hai, line graph ke trends pesh-goi ki tasdeeq karte hain, scatter plot hypothesis mein bataya gaya rishta dikhata hai. Tasweeri saboot faisle ki daleel mazboot karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Discuss ethical issues in data science, including bias, ethical use of data, and responsible communication.
Data science ke akhlaqi masail par baat karein: bias, data ka akhlaqi istemal aur zimmedarana communication.
blocks.explanation:
Data bare paimane par jama aur analyse hota hai, is liye akhlaqi masail bohat aham hain. Akhlaqi tareeqe insaf, durusti aur bharosa yaqeeni banate hain; kamzor akhlaqiyat se data ka ghalat istemal aur logon ka nuqsan hota hai. Har marhale par transparency (shaffafiyat) aur accountability (jawabdehi) zaroori hai.

1. Data jama karne aur analysis mein bias: jab data tamam groups ki munsifana numaindagi na kare (mehdood sources ya ghalat sampling); analysis mein zaati mafroozay bhi bias latay hain. Nataij ghalat aur na-munsifana. Misalein:
- Survey bias: sirf achhe schools mein survey.
- Sampling bias: sehat ki study mein sirf jawan log.
- Gender bias: hiring data mein zyada mard, to model mardon ko tarjeeh de.
- Geographical bias: shehri data se dehi (rural) faisle.
- Confirmation bias: researcher sirf apni raaye ki tasdeeq wala data le.
Ehtiyat se data jama karna aur ghair-janibdar analysis bias kam karta hai.

2. Data aur models ka akhlaqi istemal: privacy aur raazdari ka ehtram; ijazat (consent) se data lena aur sirf usi maqsad ke liye use; models imtiyazi sulook na karein; hassas (sensitive) data ko be-ijazat rasai se bachana; model design mein shaffafiyat.

3. Nataij ka zimmedarana bayan: imandari se, mubaligha ya hera-pheri ke baghair; data aur analysis ki hudood (limitations) batana; gumrah-kun graphs aur sirf pasand ke nataij batane se bachna; saaf wazahat. Sacha bayan bharosa banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Explain how to interpret hypothesis testing results and connect conclusions to hypotheses.
Hypothesis testing ke nataij ki tashreeh (interpretation) aur nateejon ko hypotheses se jorna samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation:
Nataij ki tashreeh ka matlab statistical nataij ka matlab samajhna hai taake hypothesis ke bare mein sahi faisla ho.

Test results ki tashreeh:
- Test statistic, p-value aur confidence level jaisi values ka analysis.
- Decision rule lagana: p < α (ya test statistic critical region mein) ho to H₀ reject; warna H₀ reject nahi.
- Data ke context (pas-e-manzar) ko dekhna.
- Nateeja saaf batana; ghalat tashreeh se ghalat nateeja nikalta hai.

Nateejon ko hypotheses se jorna:
- Nateeja seedha asal hypotheses se jorein aur saaf batayein ke hypothesis ki tasdeeq hui ya nahi.
- Nateeje ki daleel data aur test results se dein.
- Zaati raaye shamil na karein.
- Wazeh rabt se tehqeeq mantiqi aur mazboot banti hai; isi se research process mukammal hota hai.

Misal: teaching-method test mein t ≈ 7.93 aur p < 0.05, is liye H₀ (μ = 70) reject; H₁ se jura nateeja: naya tareeqa marks khaas tor par barhata hai. Agar p = 0.20 hoti to H₀ reject na hota aur kehte ke data behtari nahi dikhata.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka asool: "p chhoti, H₀ ki chhutti". p-value α se kam ho to H₀ reject; zyada ho to hum sirf itna kehte hain ke H₀ ko reject karne ka saboot nahi mila (yeh nahi kehte ke H₀ sabit ho gaya).

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe how findings should be communicated clearly in data analysis and why it is important.
Data analysis mein nataij wazeh tareeqe se kaise batane chahiye aur yeh kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation:
Nataij aur nateeja batana data analysis ka aham qadam hai: is se parhne wale samajhte hain ke data kya dikhata hai aur kya faisle ho sakte hain.

Nataij wazeh tareeqe se kaise batayein:
- Nataij mantiqi aur munazzam (structured) tarteeb mein.
- Wazahat ke liye tables, charts aur graphs.
- Mushkil technical alfaaz (jargon) ke bajaye saada zaban.
- Aham nukaat numaya karein.
- Nateeja sirf analyse kiye gaye data par ho aur hypotheses se jura ho.
- Imandari se pesh karein, hudood batayein, gumrah-kun graphs ya sirf pasand ke nataij se bachein.

Kyun zaroori hai:
- Nataij ki ghalat-fehmi ya ghalat istemal se bachao.
- Uljhan kam, stakeholders ki samajh behtar.
- Tehqeeq ki shaffafiyat aur saakh (credibility) barhti hai.
- Sahi faisle aur aage ki tehqeeq mein madad.
- Tehqeeq zyada mufeed aur moassar banti hai.
